children: Overview
US online learning platform's Q3 revenue rose 94% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Non-GAAP net income for Q3 climbed 242% yr/yr
Company repurchased $102 mln in shares during Q3
Outlook
Coursera sees Q4 2026 revenue between $358 mln and $366 mln
Company expects Q4 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $55 mln to $59 mln
Coursera narrows 2026 revenue outlook to $1.229 bln-$1.237 bln
Result Drivers
ENTERPRISE SEGMENT - Co said enterprise revenue rose 214% yr/yr, with gross profit up 267% and margin expanding to 81.3%
CONSUMER SEGMENT - Consumer revenue grew 35% yr/yr, with gross profit up 45% and margin rising to 65.7%
SYNERGY EXECUTION - Co said it accelerated integration execution, achieving more than $150 mln in annualized gross cost savings within eight months of the Udemy merger
